responsibility: Declares tree_vector_builder, the tree-specific wrapper around the generic vector_builder template for constructing VECTOR_CST constants. The class defines how tree elements are compared, recognized as integral, stepped, elided, and represented, exposes helpers for starting a new vector with a given encoded shape and building the final tree constant, and bridges generic pattern-based constant construction with GCC tree vector types and VECTOR_CST layout.
same_name_distinction: Declares the tree_vector_builder class and its inline tree-specific hooks on top of vector-builder.h, defining the interface, traits, and small helper logic for VECTOR_CST construction; unlike tree-vector-builder.cc, it does not perform the final tree allocation/copying implementation.
